qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the reverse gear shaft to case on the 6AZ transmission?
qa_pairs.answer: 25 Nm using M8 screws for all types.

qa_pairs.question: What screw size is used for the support for reverse gear shaft on the 7AZ transmission?
Which transmission types use M6 screws for the mounting tabs for sealing cover?
What screw size is used for the bearing on countershaft across all transmission types listed?
qa_pairs.answer: M10 screws are used for all bearing on countershaft applications.

qa_pairs.question: Which component uses M10 screws with 45 Nm torque for all transmission types?
qa_pairs.answer: The reverse gear shaft to case uses M10 screws with 45 Nm torque for all transmission types.

qa_pairs.question: Which transmission types require 25 Nm torque for the support for reverse gear shaft?
qa_pairs.answer: 240/260 transmission types require 25 Nm torque using M8 screws.
